executive_bench.name: Robert Vance
executive_bench.title: Chief Executive Officer
executive_bench.background: Promoted from COO in 2022. Joined Apex 2014 as VP Stores. Prior: Kohl's regional ops roles (1998-2014).
executive_bench.decision_style: data-driven, debate-tolerant, deliberate; takes time on big calls
executive_bench.known_for: store experience focus; less digitally fluent than peers

executive_bench.name: Margaret Chen
executive_bench.title: Chief Financial Officer
executive_bench.background: Joined from Williams-Sonoma in 2023. Prior: Macy's FP&A (2015-2019), JP Morgan retail equity research (2008-2015). CPA, CFA.
executive_bench.decision_style: decisive on cost takeout; cautious on capex; strong relationship with Audit Committee

executive_bench.name: David Okonjo
executive_bench.title: Chief Operating Officer
executive_bench.background: Promoted from EVP Stores in 2024. Joined Apex 2019. Prior: Target store operations (2008-2019).
executive_bench.decision_style: operations-first; skeptical of corporate initiatives that don't reach the store level
executive_bench.known_for: vocal critic of the failed 2023 AMS consolidation

executive_bench.name: Jennifer Park
executive_bench.title: Chief Marketing Officer
executive_bench.background: Joined 2021 from Sephora. Prior: L'Oréal digital marketing (2012-2021).
executive_bench.decision_style: fast-moving; vendor-friendly; spends quickly when she sees opportunity
executive_bench.known_for: owns the largest discretionary budget after merchandising; sponsors apex-cdp-2026
concerns_flagged: digital marketing inflation eroding contribution margin

executive_bench.name: Lynne Stratham
executive_bench.title: Chief Data Officer
executive_bench.background: Joined October 2025 from Albertsons (VP Data). Prior: Walmart data engineering (2014-2022). Strong on data foundations; learning retail-specific operational data.
executive_bench.decision_style: deliberate; building consensus; not yet a strong veto player at exec table
executive_bench.known_for: replaced Marcus Holloway who left July 2025 for unspecified reasons

executive_bench.name: Carlos Rivera
executive_bench.title: Chief Information Officer
executive_bench.background: Promoted from VP Infrastructure in 2020. Joined Apex 2017. Prior: Best Buy IT leadership (2009-2017).
executive_bench.decision_style: pragmatic; vendor-skeptical after the 2023 AMS failure; protective of his team
executive_bench.known_for: personally absorbed blame for the 2023 AMS consolidation pause; rebuilt CIO credibility through 2024-2025
executive_bench.reports_to_relationship: reports to COO, not CEO; structural choice from 2020 reorg that some on Board view as suboptimal

executive_bench.name: Sarah Whitfield
executive_bench.title: Chief Information Security Officer
executive_bench.background: Joined from Target (2023). Prior: Target CISO office (2018-2023), Mandiant consulting (2014-2018). CISSP, former active-duty USAF cyber.
executive_bench.decision_style: evidence-driven; will block initiatives that lack appropriate controls; respected but not always popular
executive_bench.known_for: ran the November 2025 PCI assessment with zero material findings

executive_bench.name: Patricia Okonkwo
executive_bench.title: Chief Sustainability Officer
executive_bench.background: Joined 2024 from REI (VP Sustainability). Prior: Patagonia (2015-2024).
executive_bench.decision_style: advocacy posture; works closely with brand and merchandising
executive_bench.known_for: successful regenerative cotton program launch in FY2024

executive_bench.name: Thomas Brennan
executive_bench.title: Chief Human Resources Officer
executive_bench.background: Joined 2022 from Lowe's. Prior: Walmart HR (2010-2022).
executive_bench.known_for: launched the AI literacy program in early FY2026

executive_bench.name: Angela Foster
executive_bench.title: Chief Merchandising Officer
executive_bench.background: Joined 2020 from Anthropologie. Prior: Free People merchandising (2014-2020).
executive_bench.decision_style: instinct-driven; suspicious of pure-data approaches that ignore taste; powerful internally
executive_bench.known_for: private-label apparel margin program (delivered 220bp gross margin lift FY2024-2025)
executive_bench.stance_on_ai: willing to use it for forecasting and assortment, skeptical of using it for creative/curation decisions

executive_bench.name: Michael Tanaka
executive_bench.title: Chief Supply Chain Officer
executive_bench.background: Joined 2023 from Macy's. Prior: Gap Inc. supply chain (2010-2020), McKinsey (2008-2010).
executive_bench.decision_style: strategic but operationally hands-on; advocate for forecast modernization
executive_bench.known_for: supply chain instrumentation has been chronically under-invested; he's been pushing for modernization budget but losing to customer-facing investment

executive_bench.name: Rebecca Singh
executive_bench.title: General Counsel
executive_bench.background: Joined 2019 from Williams-Sonoma legal. Prior: BigLaw partner.
executive_bench.decision_style: highly trusted by CEO; works closely with CISO and CFO; strong veto power on AI initiatives that touch employment or pricing decisions
executive_bench.known_for: killed two AI vendor demos in 2025 that didn't pass legal review
